thread:
anna: Heads-up: support flagged customers billed to org-default because requests with projectless SA keys are routed to fallback pool. Telemetry shows surge. Anyone recognize this flow?

mike: Can you paste a sanitized header sample? might be exchange stripping project claim.

anna: Sample: 
```
AUTH=Bearer svc-abc
CLAIMS=sa:sa-123; project: none
ROUTE=fallback
BILLING=org-default
```

sasha: Router currently treats missing project as tenantless -> fallback. Quick idea: consult SA->project map before fallback. Concern: hot-path latency.

jia: Agree. Instead do cached enrichment: check token claim first, then in-memory cache (TTL 5m), then fallback. Emit cache_hit/cache_miss metrics and sample traces on miss.

mike: I'll build a sharded LRU cache, make TTL remote-configurable, and add lock contention metric. PR will include routing.attribution_mode flag (legacy|cache-first|strict).

product-ops: Console request: surface "effective tenant" + derivation reason (claim|cache|fallback) per sample. Support needs that for billing disputes.

sasha: Privacy: store only one-way hashed SA id + per-region salt (KMS) and short TTL. I'll add doc note.

anna: Canary plan: 1) telemetry-only deploy tomorrow to measure miss rate, 2) small cache-first canary (5%) next week, ramp if cache_hit_ratio > 80% and p50 latency delta <10ms. Gate rollback on quota-misattribution increase.

deploybot: deploybot: created ROLL-9137 (attribution-cache) and linked PRs.

anna: Thanks — sync in 20 to lock thresholds.

mike: joining.

jia: joining.

anna: :thumbsup:
